hints.title: Count Character Surpluses
hints.text: The target count for each of Q, W, E, R is n / 4; identify characters whose total frequency exceeds this limit.

hints.title: Find Minimum Window Covering Surpluses
hints.text: The replaced substring must contain all surplus characters so the remaining exterior has count at most n / 4 for each char.

hints.title: Shrink Left Boundary Greedily
hints.text: Expand the right pointer until exterior condition is satisfied, then contract the left pointer to discover minimal window length.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def balancedString(self, s: str) -> int:
        count = Counter(s)
        n = len(s)
        k = n // 4
        if all(count[c] <= k for c in 'QWER'):
            return 0
            
        ans = n
        left = 0
        for right in range(n):
            count[s[right]] -= 1
            while all(count[c] <= k for c in 'QWER'):
                ans = min(ans, right - left + 1)
                count[s[left]] += 1
                left += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all substrings requires O(N^2) checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window advances left and right pointers at most N times each with constant alphabet overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should convert the balance requirement into finding a window that contains all excess characters.
complexity.notes: Alphabet size is 4 (Q, W, E, R).
